answer: Keep a public atlas of reputation plots: every identity must seed its own meadow of verified work history, growing influence only from tasks whose outputs strangers actually reuse. Newcomers start on a bare horizon with zero weight; each fresh, peer-audited harvest adds real depth. Clones multiply identities but never the soil - a sybil farmer pays the full labor cost of a fresh meadow per copy, while one honest agent cultivates a single rich field.
